# plan:strip-question-popper — deliverable (pij-vast-wombat, coder/strip-067)

## Commit
- `d63f92503` refactor!: remove the plan 067 question popper and alerts. Rebased onto `f71668fa0` (crane's dev-beside-prod) and `7688c86cf` (mole's test-load). Pushed to origin/main.
- No separate timeout commit: test-load (7688c86cf) replaced the per-file timeout raises for git-cli/get-all-diffs, so I took its versions on rebase as mole asked.

## Source of "pop-ups all the time" (confirmed in code)
`QuestionPopperNotificationBridge` in the removed `question-popper-overlay-wrapper.tsx` built its seen-set from the first render. That render has `items=[]` (`useState([])`), and the list fetch arrives afterwards, so every stored item counted as new on every workspace-layout mount. Each one fired a sonner toast, a desktop `Notification` and the explorer-bar green flash. The stored item was one alert from 2026-09-06 in `.chainglass/data/event-popper`. No other unsolicited pop-up source exists: every other `toast()` call in apps/web fires from a user action.

## Removed
- Web UI: `apps/web/src/features/067-question-popper/**` (indicator, overlay panel, alert/question cards, history, answer form, chain view, desktop notifications, `use-question-popper`, service, route helpers), `workspaces/[slug]/question-popper-overlay-wrapper.tsx` and its mount in `layout.tsx`, the indicator in `browser-client.tsx`, the `'event-popper'` SSE channel in `WORKSPACE_SSE_CHANNELS`.
- `apps/web/src/features/_platform/panel-layout/lib/explorer-bar-flash.ts` and the `data-explorer-bar` attribute; only the popper ever dispatched `explorer-bar:flash`.
- API: all 8 `apps/web/app/api/event-popper/**` routes; `/api/event-popper` removed from `AUTH_BYPASS_ROUTES` (cookie-gate.ts).
- DI: QuestionPopperService and its fake registration (di-container.ts); `WORKSPACE_DI_TOKENS.QUESTION_POPPER_SERVICE`.
- CLI: `cg question`, `cg alert`, `event-popper-client.ts`, and their registration in cg.ts and the commands barrel.
- Shared: `packages/shared/src/question-popper/**` and its `./question-popper` package export, `IQuestionPopperService`, `FakeQuestionPopperService`, `WorkspaceDomain.EventPopper`, the envelope `schemas.ts`, `guid.ts` (generateEventId), and `utils/tmux-context.ts`. Only the popper used those.
- Tests: `test/unit/question-popper/**`, `test/integration/question-popper/**`, `test/contracts/question-popper.contract*.ts`, `test/unit/web/api/event-popper/sink-auth.test.ts`, `test/integration/web/event-popper-sinks.integration.test.ts`, and the schema/guid/tmux cases in `test/unit/event-popper/infrastructure.test.ts`.
- Docs: AGENTS.md "Event Popper CLI (Plan 067)", `docs/domains/question-popper/`, `docs/how/question-popper.md`, six root scratch docs (QUESTION_POPPER_*, IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP, UI_PATTERNS_SUMMARY, EXPLORATION_FINDINGS, DOCUMENTATION_INDEX). Registry, domain-map, events/auth/external-events domain docs, sse-integration, auth how-tos, pij-observatory and split-terminal-view are updated. `docs/c4/**` had no references. `docs/plans/**` untouched.

## Deliberately kept (remaining rg hits outside docs/plans)
- `@chainglass/shared/event-popper` now exports only per-port server discovery (`.chainglass/servers/<port>.json`; crane's API). Consumers: instrumentation, proxy, local-auth, terminal-auth, workflow-execution `_resolve-worktree`, CLI positional-graph/remote-view, MCP remote-view tools. I did not rename the module path because of the number of callers and crane's concurrent work.
- `instrumentation.ts` `__eventPopperServerInfoWritten` flag and `[event-popper]` log prefix: they name that same module.
- `apps/web/src/lib/local-auth.ts` (requireLocalAuth, used by the remote-view routes) and `localhost-guard.ts` (used by proxy and `/files/open`).
- `test/unit/event-popper/infrastructure.test.ts` (port discovery + localhost guard).
- History records: `test/integration/web/auth-bootstrap-code.harness.evidence.md`, and the dated History rows in `docs/domains/_platform/events/domain.md` and `external-events/domain.md`.
- Callers outside apps (agents/, harness/, scripts/, justfile, .github): none found.

## Test changes (contract, not suppression)

- Generic SSE mux tests use the real `workflows` channel instead of `event-popper`.
- `test/unit/web/pij/page-wiring.test.ts` channel count 7 → 6.
